# Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta1

This is the frontend half of the paired architecture beta line with **Navimower 0.5.0-beta1**.

## Beta 1 scope

The backend begins building the new Canonical Mower State in shadow mode and exposes privacy-safe parity diagnostics. The Map Card deliberately keeps the proven 0.3.7 rendering behavior during this first verification beta.

There is no Map API v2 cutover yet. Current-cycle, prepared live/history resources, controls, Schedule, notifications, Gate areas, underlays and Multi mower continue to use the existing stable contract.

This pairing is intentional:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta1
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta1

Beta2 is planned to switch the paired releases to the new authoritative backend/resource contract after Canonical v2 parity has been field-tested.
